lead: `cargo build --release` by hand cannot replace `target/release/nvs.exe` while an editor's `nvs lsp` holds it
body: , and on Windows it fails with `failed to remove file ... Zugriff verweigert (os error 5)`. A `nvs.path` pointing at that binary is a lock on it for the life of the window, so a release build made to test a server change silently leaves the old binary in place and the editor keeps answering from it. `tools/dossier.py` and `tools/loop.py` retry that failure once with the old binary renamed aside (`tools/relink.py`), so a release build through either owes nothing — by hand, stop the server first with `nvs.lsp.enable` set to `false`, or close the window.
